test_grad: test that functorch grad produces correct gradients for PyTorch ops against autograd reference
test_vjp: test that functorch vjp matches autograd-based vector-Jacobian product for PyTorch ops
test_jvp: test that functorch jvp matches forward-mode AD Jacobian-vector product for PyTorch ops
test_vmapvjp: test that vmap over vjp is correct by comparing looped and batched outputs
test_vjpvmap: test that vjp over vmap is correct by comparing against autograd reference
